home.overline: For UPT students, made by students
home.tagline: Your UPT campus, in one app.
home.pitch: CampusPulse puts your timetable, exams, the campus map and Campus Virtual in one place. The Android app is coming; the web app works now.
home.notice: A student project. Not an official UPT app.

preview.title: Built for your daily student life at UPT
preview.subtitle: See how your classes, room locations, and deadlines look in one unified, distraction-free view.

timetable.title: Your timetable
timetable.description: Your group's week, with odd and even weeks, holidays and your optional labs already applied.

exams.title: Exams
exams.description: Dates and rooms for your exams, as soon as the faculty publishes them.

map.title: Campus map
map.description: Find B528A or 303CP without asking around.

campusVirtual.title: Campus Virtual
campusVirtual.description: Your courses and deadlines from Campus Virtual, read-only.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body: This page will describe what data CampusPulse collects, why, where it is stored, how long it is kept, and how to contact us. Google Play requires it before the app can be published.

accountDeletion.title: Delete your account
accountDeletion.body: This page will explain how to delete your CampusPulse account and which data is removed. Google Play requires a web page for this, separate from the option inside the app.
